subject: world_language
concept: Writing creatively (a short story or poem) in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR C1 'creative writing' extension — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans a short creative piece using a simple story/poem organizer in the target language
exercise.abstract: Student writes an original short creative piece (story or poem) in the target language

assessment.mastery_threshold: piece is original, coherent, and uses target-language vocabulary and structures appropriately
misconception_flags: writes a piece that is grammatically correct but not genuinely original or creative in content

interest_binding: creative prompt generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
